top_signals.title: Hedge Funds Halved Short Bets on Yen Since Joint Intervention
top_signals.summary: Hedge funds further dialed back on their wagers against the yen, signaling a reduction in negative sentiment surrounding the currency after the US and Japan’s historic joint intervention.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
